page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head at the top centre. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes. Scan marks and edge fragments at the right edge are not printed text.

main_text.p: erant, (reliquos enim fatum confum-pferat,) demum dimissi: quorum in numero fuit Polybius, qui Romæ manere apud principes civitatis, quibus carus esse cæperat, quàm in patriam pessimorum hominum Callicrati similium libidini jam servientem redire[?] maluit. Eodem tempore, quo hi dimissi fuêre, quod accidit L. Quintio Flaminio, M. Acilio Balbo consulibus, cum initia surgerent belli Punici iii, prætor Achæorum[?] erat Menalcidas Spartanus Callicrate nequitiâ non inferior. Et eum in prætura secutus est Diæus Megalopolitanus utroque illo nihilo melior. Horum improbitate ob pecuniam Oropiam male partam à Menalcidâ, de qua inter se diffidebant, conflatum est bellum inter Achæos & Lacedæmonios: quod velut manu duxit Romanos ad arma contra Achæos capienda, quibus tandem duce L. Mummio Achæi magno prælio superati, Corinthus urbs Achaiæ primaria capta & excisa, Achæorum respub. funditus deleta, Achaia cum cæteris Græciæ regionibus Romanorum provincia facta.

page.notes: The word "fuêre" is printed with a circumflex-like mark; read as fuère. The mark after "redire" and after "Achæorum" is a small hook-like sign that may be an abbreviation or a damaged letter; marked [?]. "delcta" is printed "deleta" with a damaged e; left as read in the scan as "deleta" with uncertainty. At the right edge there are small marks and fragments (apparently binding or scan artefacts, possibly show-through); not transcribed.
